pro_course_detail.title: The English Cafe |☕| Conversation, Grammar, Natural Expression, Functional and Useful Language Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Benvenuti to The English Cafe! Here we'll craft your ideal English learning experience. Here's a taste of what's available:

1. Do you want to have spontaneous chats to practice your conversational English? Great! We can chat about life, a topic of your choice, etc, and find new vocabulary and more natural ways to express your thoughts. 
2. Do you prefer more structure to a lesson? I have a few options for you! 1] Speaking Lessons on various topics. These classes will be 45 or 60 minutes long and are based on a topic that I will send to you and let you choose before the lesson. This requires no preparation on your part, just show up and engage! 2] Reading and discussing an article. These will be 30 or 45-minute lessons. You will read an article before the lesson, then we will discuss it during the lesson and work on any difficult vocabulary. You will have the option to choose from a list of topics that I will send you. 3] If you struggle with any particular grammar, functional language, or vocabulary, we can do a 30, 45, or 60-minute lesson based on your needs.
3. Do you have material you want to bring to the table and get practice with? Great! Let me know what you have prepared so we can discuss and refine it.

Important: This is for strong A2/B1-C2 as you need to be comfortable chatting and holding conversations in English. All lessons are hosted entirely in English.

Spend less by booking packages of 5, 10, or 15 lessons! This not only saves money but gives you an extra reason to dedicate time to your learning.

I try to make my lessons both fun and educational. I believe that motivating my students and providing them with the necessary tools to study English more effectively are essential parts my job.

I offer two kinds of lessons:

1) I send the student an exercise that looks something like this: http://postimg.org/image/vt1qw7a0f/
During the lesson, the student answers the questions, and I help him or her with grammar, word choice, and pronunciation.

2) I send the student a newspaper or magazine article to read, and then, during the lesson, we go over any new vocabulary and discuss the contents of the article. I do this mostly with my more advanced students, as one of the best ways to progress in your English studies at the upper-intermediate level is to use authentic material (i.e. material created for native speakers of English).

pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to sound better, and also improve your LISTENING comprehension dramatically? Well, the way you speak is the way you expect to hear. Better listening comprehension means you can enjoy learning using radio, TV and movies — enjoying all the benefits of authentic native-speaker material.

This course can be taken at any time, but it is most advantageous to do so before memorizing thousands of words with inaccurate pronunciation, and before spending countless hours practicing bad prosody in conversations.

No, you will not be able to pass for a native speaker after just one session :) The goal of this course will be to aim for near-native pronunciation while we make steady progress each lesson. Language coaching is provided so you can maximize your self-study outside of our sessions.

My philosophy: You do not need “accent reduction” — you do not need to reduce anything. Your native accent is perfect — for your native language. What you need is accent acquisition — to acquire a subconscious mastery of the characteristic phonology of your target language that will allow you to speak “naturally” and LISTEN as easily as a native.

Depending on your personal goals and what we uncover during our first conversation, we may perfect your consonants, vowels, stress, intonation, rhythm, etc. We can improve all of these at either a basic or advanced level, as needed.

Video or just audio — it’s your decision, as I can tell exactly how you’re using your lips, tongue, etc., just by listening.

The price of this course is a little bit higher than the standard “Conversational English with Integrated Grammar” because 99.9% of English teachers don’t have the skills to teach it. You will experience noticeable improvement after every session — guaranteed. Write me for additional information.

📌 Enhance Reading Comprehension: Understand and interpret complex texts.
📌 Expand Vocabulary: Learn new words and phrases in context.

Digital Comics 📱:

The digital comics used in the course are free and accessible online. Expect works from creators like Rachel Smythe (Lore Olympus), Megan Kearney (Beauty and the Beast), and Sarah Andersen (Sarah’s Scribbles).

Illustrated Novels 📚:

For the novels, you’ll need to purchase them. We’ll explore works by authors such as Neil Gaiman (Sandman, Coraline), Brian K. Vaughan (Saga, Y: The Last Man), and Marjorie Liu (Monstress),
